notes.title: New Game Announcement | Cafe Paris
notes.content:
We are super excited to announce our new game currently in development. 

Presenting Cafe Paris!
A 3D narrative coffee shop sim located in the heart of Paris. In this game you run "Cafe Paris". A 24/7 open coffee shop establishment between the foot of the Eiffel Tower & the banks of the Seine river. Serve coffee & food to your customers and learn about their stories.

- Greet customers that will come in at all times of the day. 
- Serve them coffee and food. 
- Enjoy the atmosphere of Paris as you serve and interact with customers all day and night with the Eiffel Tower in view. 
- Speak with your patrons and learn their stories and where they come from. Each customer will have their own unique storyline that you can influence.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1612330/Cafe_Paris/

notes.title: Patch to The Most Boring Game Ever
notes.content:
Hello, 

I just released a patch to fix some of the issues noted as well as added a mechanic update. 

1). Build size has now been reduced from 700 Mb to just 40 Mb. There was a pesky little file in the project folder I decided not to use that was large but was still being included with the game build. Oopsie. :) 

2). I have added Left Mouse Click as an option to interact. Thanks for the suggestion "Odin's Wholf". 

Hope everyone is enjoying The Most Boring Game Ever! Cheers! :D
